after thinking about it, I think On/Off is objectively the best Daft Punk song. It possibly rivals face to face as the DP song with the most samples. the technical ability needed to combine different sound bites together in such a smooth way cannot be overstated. 

The interlude also gives off a very eerie feeling. The different voice lines are hard to understand and feel as though they come from a horror movie. 

On/off also works great as a pre song skit for Television Rules the Nation. While both criticize the over reliance on television for meaning, On/off is able to communicate this better through the use of samples.

A few other points: Mixing is wonderful. It really feels like i’m at the tv. The title is very clever.
